description: This file contains unit tests for the LanguageAPI class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing API functionalities such as retrieving all languages, retrieving one language, creating, updating, and deleting languages. It uses a test framework with data providers and mocks, and interacts with test fixtures and a YAML configuration for test cases.

classes.name: LanguageAPITest
classes.description: A test class for testing the LanguageAPI endpoints, including CRUD operations and retrieval of language data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures and prepares the database with Language data before each test.
